title: Normalized algebraic dualizing complexes for quotient local rings
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a nonzero commutative Noetherian local ring and let $\omega\in D(A)$ be a normalized algebraic dualizing complex [def-per-algebraic-normalized-dualizing]. Let $f:A\twoheadrightarrow B$ be a surjective homomorphism of commutative rings with $B\ne0$. Thus $B$ is Noetherian local with maximal ideal $f(\mathfrak m)$. Then $\omega_B=R\operatorname{Hom}_A(B[0],\omega)$, with its $B$-action induced by $(b\varphi)(x)=\varphi(bx)$ on a derived-Hom representative [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], is a normalized algebraic dualizing complex over $B$ [def-per-algebraic-normalized-dualizing].
